name: The River Lee
positioning: Luxury boutique hotel on a bend in the River Lee, a short walk from Cork city centre, owned by The Doyle Collection
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base within walking distance of Cork city centre
Guests who want a swimming pool, fitness club and facial treatments on site

facts.text: The River Lee is set on a bend in the river in Cork.
The hotel is a short walk from Cork city centre.
The hotel describes itself as a luxury boutique hotel.
The River Lee is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group.
Resident guests have complimentary access to the hotel's in-house health and fitness club.
The hotel's health and fitness club has a swimming pool.
The hotel's venues include The River Club, The Grill Room and The Cocktail Bar.
Cork has a cultural hub with an internationally regarded opera house, independent art galleries, museums and theatres.
Cork is well placed for visits to the Blarney Stone and the historic fishing town of Kinsale.
The hotel shares Louise O'Neill's 48 Hours in Cork guide.
The hotel's address is Western Road, Cork City, T12 X2AH.

highlights.text: The hotel offers river view luxury suites and studio suites.
KINS, an advanced facial treatment suite and aesthetics clinic, is on the hotel's first floor.
The hotel offers a weekend package blending Cork City with West Cork, curated by author Louise O'Neill.
Cork's food scene centres on the English Market.

considerations.text: The hotel is a short walk from the city centre rather than in it.
The hotel hosts corporate events and family celebrations.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may bring city noise and traffic.

sources.title: The River Lee - The Doyle Collection
